name: Scope
description: Which files a specification's include covers, and the walk that finds them.

scenarios.title: Where a walk starts
scenarios.when: the scope is asked which directories to walk
scenarios.then: it names everything before the first wildcard, and a pattern carrying none names no walk at all

scenarios.title: A root under another root
scenarios.when: the scope is asked which directories to walk
scenarios.then: only the outermost is walked, so a file is met once however many includes reach it

scenarios.title: What a walk passes over
given: a tree holding a hidden entry, a hidden directory, and a directory linked back up the tree
scenarios.then: the hidden entries are passed over and the link is not followed

scenarios.title: A root nothing wrote
given: an include naming a directory that is not there
scenarios.then: it answers nothing rather than refusing to run

scenarios.title: What an include covers
given: an include, and what the project excludes
scenarios.when: the scope is asked what it covers
scenarios.then: it answers the files the include reaches less the excluded ones, a wildcard matching a directory in the middle included

scenarios.title: A directory the walk refuses
given: an excluded directory holding files an include would otherwise reach
scenarios.then: it is not walked into at all, and what was refused is carried so an include the project emptied is told apart from one nobody could have meant
